6010.title: Cold-start signal wait expires before valid worker readiness
6010.rootCauseOneLine: The fixture waits only one second for a handler signal that follows a real worker startup allowed to take ten seconds.
6010.proposedFix: Set an explicit ten-second signal-wait budget and extend the existing overlap test with controlled real-worker initialization latency.
6010.caveats: Controlled real-worker startup reproduces the timing defect twice; the original downstream CI logs and failure frequency were not independently verified. Reproduction patch and output are inline in the report.
